diagnostic.userText: Inspect the existing "interactive-3d-model-viewer" project using your lightweight webpage inspection tools without launching Chromium. Retrieve the current GitHub source and inspect the deployed webpage. Check HTTP accessibility, HTML structure, JavaScript dependencies, import maps, missing assets, and Content Security Policy compatibility. Compare the deployed source against the repository source and identify why the viewer remains stuck on "Loading 3D Viewer..." Provide actual tool results, detected errors, and a concrete repair recommendation. Clearly distinguish verified findings from assumptions and anything requiring browser execution. Preserve the existing project identity and security restrictions. Do not create a duplicate project or modify files yet.
